otherReferenceLimits.note: Official Konami release screenshots were inspected, but none supplied the required roof view. The first-visit gameplay is the architectural source; clear-sky ending footage is excluded from phase selection.
Chase clips are used only for the normal concrete stair chamber visible beyond the maze exit. Paper-covered Otherworld corridors and phone/hand overlays are excluded.
The small walkthrough thumbnail shh_walkthrough_04a.jpg shows the already-released corridor; it is not the main architecture source.
